title: Ophiopogonin D Inhibiting Epithelial NF-kappaB Signaling Pathway Protects Against Experimental Colitis in Mice.
authors: Wang, Liang; Yang, Huibin; Qiao, Liang; Liu, Jiani; Liao, Xiaoxiao; Huang, Huan; Dong, Jianyi; Chen, Jun; Chen, Dapeng; Wang, Jingyu
one_liner_zh: 该文研究OP-D通过抑制NF-kappaB信号通路缓解小鼠结肠炎，虽含分子对接但对象为小分子-蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI/物理模拟方法创新，仅边缘相关。
abstract: The sustained activation of the nuclear factor kappaB (NF-kappaB) signaling pathway has been observed in human inflammatory bowel disease (IBD). Ophiopogonin D (OP-D) is a small molecular compound isolated from Ophiopogon japonicus, a widely used herbal remedy. In this study, dextran sodium sulfate was used to make a mouse model of experimental colitis and verify the effect of OP-D on the mouse model of experimental colitis. Small molecule-protein molecular docking approaches were also used to discover the mechanisms underlying the OP-D-induced regulation of colitis. In colitis, the OP-D can inhibit the apoptosis of intestinal mucosa cells, restore the intestinal barrier, and alleviate inflammation. The molecular docking simulations showed that OP-D had a high affinity with the REL-homology domain of NF-kappaB-p65 that affected its translocation to the nucleus. In a cell study, the effects of OP-D on inflammation and barrier dysfunction were significantly decreased by a small interfering RNA targeting NF-kappaB-p65. Further, the LPS-induced increase in NF-kappaB-p65 in the nucleus was also significantly inhibited by OP-D. OP-D alleviated experimental colitis by inhibiting NF-kappaB. New insights into the pathogenesis and treatment options of colitis are provided through this study.
abstract_zh: 核因子kappaB（NF-kappaB）信号通路的持续激活已在人类炎症性肠病（IBD）中观察到。Ophiopogonin D（OP-D）是从广泛使用的中草药麦冬（Ophiopogon japonicus）中分离出的一种小分子化合物。本研究使用葡聚糖硫酸钠建立实验性结肠炎小鼠模型，并验证OP-D对该小鼠模型的作用。同时，采用小分子-蛋白质分子对接方法探索OP-D调控结肠炎的机制。在结肠炎中，OP-D能抑制肠黏膜细胞凋亡，恢复肠道屏障，并减轻炎症。分子对接模拟显示，OP-D与NF-kappaB-p65的REL同源结构域具有高亲和力，影响其向细胞核的转位。在细胞研究中，通过靶向NF-kappaB-p65的小干扰RNA，OP-D对炎症和屏障功能障碍的作用显著降低。此外，脂多糖诱导的细胞核中NF-kappaB-p65增加也受到OP-D的显著抑制。OP-D通过抑制NF-kappaB减轻实验性结肠炎。本研究为结肠炎的发病机制和治疗选择提供了新的见解。
